title: Choose the Contact Sheet composition
question: Which layout should become the desktop app?

options.label: Proof + docket
options.thesis: A dominant proof on the left and a single task docket on the right.
options.viewport: The image owns 55 percent of the window; the task reads top to bottom beside it.
options.risk: The safest and clearest composition, with less room for multiple recent files.

options.label: Contact rail
options.thesis: A vertical strip keeps source and result proofs visible beside the selected image.
options.viewport: A narrow proof rail, central image, and compact right docket divide the window into three zones.
options.risk: More expressive, but denser at small window sizes.

options.label: Wide proof
options.thesis: The image spans the window while the workflow becomes one horizontal processing bench.
options.viewport: The proof fills the upper two-thirds; four grouped task stations run along the bottom.
options.risk: Most image-forward, but file paths have less horizontal room than they appear to.
